items.problem: The agent shipped the migration without capturing a single screenshot of the running app to confirm each scenario actually renders — it relied on build PASS + Test-AppLaunch PASS + Validate-UwpMigration PASS.
items.evidence: No 'winapp ui screenshot' / render check anywhere in trial 000 session-log.txt; the agent's closing summary declared done after the validator PASS at L2994-2999.
items.covered_clearly_at: SKILL.md L134 (prominent block-quote): '"Process alive" is not "every page works." ... After the app launches, navigate to every migrated scenario / nav entry and confirm its content frame actually renders'; reinforced at SKILL.md L162 and MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md#silent-navigation-failures (L510).
items.why_no_skill_change: The requirement to visually verify each scenario is already stated prominently and repeatedly. The contributing factor that made it skippable — the validator's over-confident PASS wording — is handled as a separate skill-defect (Validate-UwpMigration message fix). Once that message no longer implies 'render verified', a capable model following the existing SKILL.md L134 guidance would screenshot and catch the blank without further prose changes. Adding yet another 'please screenshot' paragraph would just bloat the skill.
